children: Farmers & Merchants Bancshares appointed Mark C. Krebs to its Board of Directors and to the Asset/Liability, Investor Relations, and Nominating Committees.
Director (Class I) of Farmers & Merchants Bancshares and Farmers & Merchants Bank; member of Asset/Liability, Investor Relations, and Nominating Committees
Board election to fill director position (term through 2027 annual meeting)

66 years old; former Treasurer & CFO of the Company (Aug 2016–Jun 30, 2025) and Executive VP–CFO of the Bank (Apr 2017–Jun 30, 2025); advisor to the Board from Sep 15, 2025 until election; prior finance roles at Fieldstone Investment, American Home Mortgage/Columbia National, and KPMG.
Appointed to Asset/Liability, Investor Relations, and Nominating Committees
